description: per-mode fare structure: a leg (one boarding) costs base_php which covers included_km, plus rate_php_per_km for every km beyond. replaces the old per-edge fare sums that double-charged multi-segment rail rides (north ave to taft summed to 53 php against the published ~28 php). sources pending final citation from the fare research sweep - verify before the defense.

LRT-1.source: lrta/dotr fare adjustment (boarding fare + per-km component)

LRT-2.source: lrta/dotr fare adjustment (boarding fare + per-km component)

MRT-3.source: dotr-mrt3 fare matrix, calibrated so north ave to taft lands near the published end-to-end fare

EDSA-Bus.source: ltfrb city bus (aircon) fare structure applied to the edsa carousel - confirm with the carousel research sweep

Jeepney.source: ltfrb traditional jeepney fare matrix (base for first 4 km + per-succeeding-km)
